name: Facebook Pages
description: Facebook Pages curated publishing operations with a manually supplied OAuth2 token.

fields.label: Existing Page OAuth2 access token (manual renewal)
Facebook Page ID matching the Page token

healthcheck.title: Read the identity represented by the supplied Page access token
healthcheck.description: Read the identity represented by the supplied Page access token. Use a Page token matching the configured pageId.

posts.list.title: List the configured Page feed
posts.list.description: List the configured Page feed. Follow after cursors only while pages contain results.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from the prior response. Omit for the first page.
Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider. A cursor alone does not prove there is another page.

posts.create.title: Publish a text or link post to the configured Page immediately
posts.create.description: Publish a text or link post to the configured Page immediately.

message.description: Text content of the Page post.

posts.schedule.title: Schedule a Page post
posts.schedule.description: Schedule a Page post. The provider requires a publish time between 10 minutes and 30 days from the request; confirm the schedule in Facebook.

message.description: Text content of the Page post.

scheduledPublishTime.description: Future Unix timestamp in seconds; provider validates the scheduling window.

postId.description: Scheduled Page post ID; not evidence it has already published.

posts.update.title: Update message text of a Page post created by the same app
posts.update.description: Update message text of a Page post created by the same app. Other posts cannot be edited.

postId.description: Page post ID belonging to the Page represented by this token.

posts.delete.title: Delete an existing Page post using the Page token
posts.delete.description: Delete an existing Page post using the Page token.

postId.description: Page post ID belonging to the Page represented by this token.

photos.publish.title: Publish a photo to the configured Page from a public URL fetched by Meta
photos.publish.description: Publish a photo to the configured Page from a public URL fetched by Meta. No binary upload is performed.

url.description: Public photo URL that Meta can fetch.

pages.get.title: Read the configured Page
pages.get.description: Read the configured Facebook Page profile fields.

posts.get.description: Read a Facebook Page post by ID.

comments.list.description: List comments on a Facebook Page post. Follow after cursors only while pages contain results.

postId.description: Page post ID belonging to the Page represented by this token.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

comments.create.description: Publish a comment on a Facebook Page post as the Page.

comments.get.description: Read a Facebook comment by ID.

commentId.description: Comment ID on a Page post.

comments.delete.title: Delete a comment
comments.delete.description: Delete a Facebook comment using the Page token.

commentId.description: Comment ID on a Page post.

photos.list.description: List photos on the configured Facebook Page.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

videos.list.description: List videos on the configured Facebook Page.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from the prior response. Omit for the first page.
Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider.

reactions.list.title: List reactions on a Page post
reactions.list.description: List reactions on a Facebook Page post.

postId.description: Page post ID belonging to the Page represented by this token.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from the prior response. Omit for the first page.
Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider.

insights.get.title: Get Page insights
insights.get.description: Read Facebook Page insights metrics for the configured Page.

period.description: Aggregation period such as day, week, or days_28.

albums.list.title: List Page albums
albums.list.description: List photo albums on the configured Facebook Page.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from the prior response. Omit for the first page.
Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider.

events.list.title: List Page events
events.list.description: List events on the configured Facebook Page.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from the prior response. Omit for the first page.
Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider.

conversations.list.title: List Page conversations
conversations.list.description: List Messenger conversations for the configured Facebook Page.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from the prior response. Omit for the first page.
Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider.

tasks.create.title: Assign tasks to a business-scoped user on the configured Page
tasks.create.description: Assign Page tasks to a business-scoped or system user via POST /{page-id}/assigned_users. The token must be a Page access token with the MANAGE task and the pages_manage_metadata permission; regular Facebook user IDs are rejected.

user.description: Business-scoped user ID or system user ID to assign tasks to.

tasks.description: Page tasks to assign, such as MANAGE, CREATE_CONTENT, MODERATE, ADVERTISE, ANALYZE or MESSAGING.

posts.createMultiPhoto.title: Publish a multi-photo feed post to the configured Page
posts.createMultiPhoto.description: Publish one Page feed post referencing already-uploaded unpublished photos via POST /{page-id}/feed with attached_media. Upload each photo first with published=false; this operation posts the feed story and does not upload files.

message.description: Optional text to publish with the photo post.

media_fbid.description: ID of an unpublished Page photo.

attachedMedia.description: Unpublished photo references attached to the feed post.

videos.publish.title: Publish a video to the configured Page from a public URL fetched by Meta
videos.publish.description: Publish a video to the configured Facebook Page from a public file URL via POST /{page-id}/videos. No binary upload is performed; use a direct MP4 URL Meta can fetch.

fileUrl.description: Public video file URL that Meta can fetch.

scheduledPublishTime.description: Future Unix timestamp in seconds; requires published=false.

messages.list.title: List messages in a Page conversation
messages.list.description: List messages in a Facebook Page conversation via GET /{conversation-id}/messages. Follow after cursors only while pages contain results.

conversationId.description: Conversation ID such as t_3638640842939952 from conversations.list.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from the prior response. Omit for the first page.
Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider.

objects.get.title: Read a Graph object by ID
objects.get.description: Read caller-selected fields from an identified Facebook Graph node via GET /{object-id}. Use me for the connected identity; permissions must already allow the requested fields.

objectId.description: Facebook Graph object ID, or me for the connected user.

fields.description: Optional comma-separated Graph fields to return.

messages.get.title: Get a Page message
messages.get.description: Read a message sent or received by the configured Page via GET /{message-id}.

messageId.description: ID of the message to retrieve.

fields.description: Optional comma-separated message fields to return.

roles.list.title: List Page roles
roles.list.description: List people and their tasks on the configured Facebook Page via GET /{page-id}/roles. Business-scoped users appear on the assigned_users edge instead.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from the prior response. Omit for the first page.
Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider.

tagged.list.title: List posts tagging the configured Page
tagged.list.description: List public posts in which the configured Facebook Page is tagged via GET /{page-id}/tagged.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from the prior response. Omit for the first page.
Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider.

postInsights.get.title: Get post insights
postInsights.get.description: Read metrics for a specific Page post via GET /{post-id}/insights. New posts may return empty metric values.

postId.description: Page post ID belonging to the Page represented by this token.

posts.listScheduled.title: List scheduled Page posts
posts.listScheduled.description: List scheduled and unpublished posts for the configured Page via GET /{page-id}/scheduled_posts. Use it to check for duplicates before scheduling.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from the prior response. Omit for the first page.
Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider.

likes.create.title: Like a post or comment as the configured Page
likes.create.description: Add a LIKE reaction to a Page post or comment via POST /{object-id}/likes. Only LIKE can be added programmatically and the Page must not have reacted already.

objectId.description: Page post or comment ID to react to.

adAccounts.list.title: List ad accounts for a user
adAccounts.list.description: List ad accounts available to a Facebook user via GET /{user-id}/adaccounts. Use me for the connected user.

userId.description: User ID whose ad accounts to list, or me for the connected user.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from the prior response. Omit for the first page.
Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider.

businesses.list.title: List businesses for a user
businesses.list.description: List Business Manager businesses associated with a Facebook user via GET /{user-id}/businesses. Use me for the connected user.

userId.description: User ID whose businesses to list, or me for the connected user.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from the prior response. Omit for the first page.
Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider.

managedPages.list.title: List Pages managed by a user
managedPages.list.description: List Facebook Pages managed by a user, including tasks and page tokens, via GET /{user-id}/accounts. Use me for the connected user; requires the pages_show_list permission.

userId.description: User ID whose managed Pages to list, or me for the connected user.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from the prior response. Omit for the first page.
Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider.

ownedPages.list.title: List Pages owned by a business
ownedPages.list.description: List Facebook Pages owned by a Business Manager business via GET /{business-id}/owned_pages.

businessId.description: Business Manager business ID whose owned Pages to list.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from the prior response. Omit for the first page.
Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider.

permissions.list.title: List permissions for a user
permissions.list.description: List granted, declined or expired permissions for a Facebook user and app via GET /{user-id}/permissions. Use me for the connected user.

userId.description: User ID whose permissions to list, or me for the connected user.

permission.description: Optional permission name to filter, such as email.

after.description: Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider.

messages.updateSeen.title: Mark a user's message as seen by the configured Page
messages.updateSeen.description: Send the Send API sender_action mark_seen for a user's message via POST /{page-id}/messages. Requires an open messaging window with the recipient.

recipientId.description: Page-scoped ID of the user whose message to mark as seen.

posts.publish.title: Publish a scheduled or unpublished Page post
posts.publish.description: Publish a scheduled or unpublished Page post immediately by setting is_published=true via POST /{post-id}.

postId.description: Scheduled or unpublished Page post ID.

scrape.update.title: Refresh the Facebook scrape cache for a URL
scrape.update.description: Ask Facebook to rescrape a public URL via POST /?id={url}&scrape=true, optionally returning requested metadata fields.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL whose scrape metadata should be refreshed.

fields.description: Optional comma-separated URL metadata fields to return after the refresh.

scrape.description: Refreshed scrape metadata for the URL.

tasks.delete.title: Remove a user's tasks from the configured Page
tasks.delete.description: Remove a business-scoped user's tasks from the configured Page via DELETE /{page-id}/assigned_users?user={user}. Caller needs admin rights on the Page.

user.description: Business-scoped user ID or system user ID whose tasks to remove.

posts.reschedule.title: Reschedule an unpublished Page post
posts.reschedule.description: Change scheduled_publish_time of a scheduled Page post via POST /{post-id}. The provider requires a future time within its scheduling window.

scheduledPublishTime.description: New future Unix timestamp in seconds.

targeting.search.title: Search geographic ad targeting locations
targeting.search.description: Search current geographic keys accepted by Meta ad targeting via GET /search?type=adgeolocation.

query.description: Text prefix used to autocomplete locations.

locationTypes.description: Geographic location categories to include in the search.

countryCode.description: ISO country code used to constrain results.

regionId.description: Meta region ID used to constrain results.

matchCountryCode.description: Match the query against country codes instead of country names.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from the prior response. Omit for the first page.

pages.search.title: Search Facebook Pages
pages.search.description: Search Facebook Pages by query string via GET /pages/search. Requires the Page Public Metadata or Page Public Content Access app feature.

query.description: Search query such as a business name or topic.

fields.description: Optional comma-separated Page fields to return.

limit.description: Requested page size; provider validates its allowed range.

after.description: Opaque continuation cursor, if supplied by the provider.

messages.create.title: Send a text message from the configured Page
messages.create.description: Send a Messenger text message from the configured Page to a user via POST /{page-id}/messages. Requires an open messaging window or an eligible tag; the recipient must be a page-scoped ID.

recipientId.description: Page-scoped ID of the message recipient.

tag.description: Message tag, required when messagingType is MESSAGE_TAG.

recipientId.description: Recipient the message was sent to.

messages.createMedia.title: Send a media message from the configured Page
messages.createMedia.description: Send an image, video, audio or file message from the configured Page via POST /{page-id}/messages using a public media URL.

recipientId.description: Page-scoped ID of the message recipient.

mediaUrl.description: Public URL of the media to send.

tag.description: Message tag, required when messagingType is MESSAGE_TAG.

recipientId.description: Recipient the message was sent to.

messages.updateTyping.title: Toggle the typing indicator for a Messenger user
messages.updateTyping.description: Show or hide the typing indicator for a user via POST /{page-id}/messages with sender_action typing_on or typing_off.

recipientId.description: Page-scoped ID of the user to show or hide the indicator for.

likes.delete.title: Unlike a post or comment as the configured Page
likes.delete.description: Remove the configured Page's LIKE reaction from a post or comment via DELETE /{object-id}/likes.

objectId.description: Page post or comment ID to remove the like from.

comments.update.title: Update a comment
comments.update.description: Update a comment's message or hidden state via POST /{comment-id}. The comment must belong to a post on a Page managed by the token.

commentId.description: Comment ID on a Page post.

isHidden.description: Whether to hide or unhide the comment.

pages.update.title: Update settings of the configured Page
pages.update.description: Update updatable Page fields such as about, description, general_info, phone, website and emails via POST /{page-id}. Not all fields are available for every Page category.

about.description: Updated about section for the Page.

batch.create.title: Send a Graph API batch request
batch.create.description: Send up to 50 independent Graph API calls in one POST / request via the batch parameter. Each item has method, relative_url and an optional form-encoded body; the provider returns one JSON-encoded result per item.

method.description: HTTP method of the batch item.

relative_url.description: Graph path of the batch item, such as me/feed.

body.description: Form-encoded body for POST or PUT items.

name.description: Optional item name for result references.

batch.description: Batch items serialized as JSON on the batch query parameter.

data.description: One result object per batch item.
